# RFC 130 phase 0 baseline

Captured on 2026-09-12 using the implementation in the same commit as this
report, based on `dbf0a87b51`. This is the existing execution path; there is no
fused operator or speedup claim in phase 0. The primary dataset and measurement
protocol are defined in [the capability and harness contract](parallel-hash-join-group-by.md).

Hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 7900 (12 cores / 24 threads), 61 GiB system memory,
Linux x86_64, local NVMe storage. Warm native data; no other tests or builds ran
during measurement. JVM and dataset settings printed by the runner:

```text
# revision=dbf0a87b51-phase0-working-tree java=25.0.4 vm=OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM os=Linux arch=amd64 processors=24 heap_max=8589934592 vm_args=[--add-exports=java.base/jdk.internal.vm=ALL-UNNAMED, --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED, --sun-misc-unsafe-memory-access=allow, -Xmx8g]
# rows=100000000 plants=100000 selected_percent=10 fanout=1 seed=130 workers=4 warmups=3 runs=10 repetitions=2 storage=warm-native
```

Three warmups before each round, then ten measured cursor acquisitions through
consumption of all 120 ordered groups. Every result was checked. Native memory
is a 1 ms sampled process allocation delta, excluding heap and mapped files;
brief peaks and allocations retained in shared pools limit its interpretation.

```text
# baseline repetition=0 median_ms=2464.540 min_ms=2399.713 max_ms=2551.223
# baseline repetition=1 median_ms=2422.315 min_ms=2362.882 max_ms=2518.286
```

## Existing plan

```text
Encode sort light
  keys: [country, yr, mo]
    VirtualRecord
      functions: [country,memoize(year),memoize(month),total_energy_kwh,avg_irradiance,total_energy_kwh/nullif(sum,0)]
        GroupBy vectorized: false
          keys: [country,year,month]
          values: [sum(energy_kwh),avg(irradiance_wm2),sum(installed_kwp)]
            SelectedRecord
                Hash Join Light
                  condition: p.plant_id=r.plant_id
                    PageFrame
                        Row forward scan
                        Interval forward scan on: fact_solar_readings
                          intervals: [("2020-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z","2024-12-31T23:59:59.999999Z")]
                    Hash
                        Async JIT Filter workers: 4
                          filter: country in [ES,IT]
                            PageFrame
                                Row forward scan
                                Frame forward scan on: dim_plant
```
